messages:
chen: Quick sync — I'm pushing a change to the analytics event schema for token-cost attribution (adds `billing_unit` + `model_variant`). Need to confirm owners and a release window.

maria: Thanks — can you share the delta? want to verify it won't break the latency breakdown dashboards.

chen: pasted the patch inline:```json
{
  "event": "token_usage",
  "user_id": "<redacted>",
  "tokens": 125,
  "billing_unit": "token",
  "model_variant": "gptx-8q",
  "ingest_ts": 1714098652000
}
```

trent: Heads up — ingester (ingest-service) currently drops unknown top-level fields. We need a deploy on ingest-service to accept `billing_unit` and `model_variant` before the schema is live. I can own that if we pick a date.

alice: @chen can you open a PR with schema version bump? I'll do code review. Also, add a lint rule so telemetry tests fail if new required fields are added without a migration note.

chen: Will open PR today. For rollout timing: propose canary tomorrow 09:30 PT, full rollout 11:00 PT if no regressions.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: ingest-service-canary -> 2025-03-15 09:30 PT (triggered by trent). ETA ~10m.

maria: For dashboards: we should namespace latency tags by `model_variant` so we can see per-variant p95. Also confirm whether existing token aggregation queries need to be re-run for historical cost backfill.

sasha: I can take ownership of the dashboard changes and the backfill plan. I'll coordinate with analytics infra for a backfill job.

ben: Question on cost math — are we switching to billing per `billing_unit` or keeping current `token` granularity? Need to update cost attribution docs accordingly.

chen: Long-term we keep token granularity but surface `billing_unit` so teams can opt into alternate billing (e.g., block-based for quantized models). For now, treat `billing_unit` as metadata only.

alice: PR opened: https://git.company/redwood/telemetry/compare/PR-214 — includes schema bump, tests, and migration notes. PTAL @trent @sasha.

trent: Reviewing now. One small ask: add an integration test asserting ingest-service forwards the `model_variant` into the event stream (kinesis topic).

maria: If ingest passes, I can run the dashboard queries against canary data and report p95/p99 diffs.

chen: Great — owners: ingest=trent, dashboard/backfill=sasha, PR review=alice, cost-docs=ben.

ben: I'll draft a short doc and link it in the PR description.

alice: Minor CI flake on telemetry-tests fixed. @chen can you rebase?

chen: rebased and pushed.

trent: Can confirm canary ingest accepted the fields and the kinesis producer emitted messages with `model_variant`. No errors seen in the canary window.

maria: Ran the dashboard checks on canary slice — no latency regressions attributable to schema change. p95 variance < 1%.

sasha: Backfill plan: one-off Spark job to rehydrate cost aggregates for the last 30 days. I'll open a run request after we merge.

chen: OK let's merge after 11:00 PT if no objections. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ben: One follow-up: request tagging guidance in docs — I'll add examples of SQL to join `token_usage` events to charge buckets.

infra-bot: deploy completed: ingest-service-canary -> success (09:41 PT).

alice: Merged. Rollout now proceeding to full.

chen: Full rollout started, monitoring dashboards + error rates. Ping here if you see anything odd.

maria: All clear so far.

trent: No anomalies from ingest side.

sasha: Backfill scheduled for 16:30 PT, will post run id.

ben: Doc changes in https://docs.redwood.com/instrumentation/costs (draft), will finalize after backfill.

chen: Thanks all — closing this thread once backfill finishes.
